claim_one_line: THE TRADE-OFF'S TWO ENDS ARE EXACT FOR EVERY CHANNEL (PROVED; data-free; P-879): from B1736's closed form, Y h = (h.h) u and h^T Y = (h.h) u^T for every Higgs and channel, so a null Higgs gives m1 = 0 with left null vector conj(h), and the conjugate reading's light state h is exactly orthogonal to it whatever the channels (B1739's lemma without 'channels off'); a real Higgs is flavour-blind up to the reflection 1 - 2 h h^T (Y times it is c 1 + [a]_x), so B1727's sharp floor m2/m3 >= 1/3 holds for every channel, making B1740's non-null loss a theorem at reality 1; a null Higgs's heavy pair has m2 m3 = |h|^2 |u1^2 + u.u|, the channels' near-nullity; under the charge rule neither end gives an aligned mixing with a hierarchy, and the interior stays open. 0 of 19.
